summary.intent: Clear 18 outstanding human-UAT verification debt items across phases 19.1, 21, and 35 of the CipherBox project, using Puppeteer MCP to drive the browser autonomously rather than requiring manual user testing.
summary.outcome: All 18 UAT debt items cleared (18 → 0) across all three phases. A latent browser-only bug in the BYO pinning providers was found, fixed, and verified end-to-end. A local TEE worker stack was stood up. Stale Phala CVM documentation was updated. Six commits landed on branch `fix/pinning-provider-fetch-binding`.

repo: Email OTP codes are logged to the API console as `DEV OTP for <email>: <code>` when SendGrid is not configured, enabling fully self-serve automated login in local dev.

Pinning mode 'external only' or 'dual' is stored per-account in the vault config; the StorageTab save button is hard-gated on a successful TEE connection test (`disabled={mode !== 'cipherbox' && !testResult?.success}`).
No web caller exists for `PATCH /vault/byo-status` anywhere in `apps/web/src` — the advisory quota badge in StorageQuota.tsx renders correctly but is unreachable through the product UI flow.
MigrationProgress component permanently stops polling after any terminal job status and does not restart when a new save is triggered.

Phase 35 retired Phala Cloud CVM for staging in PR #472 and replaced it with the Docker simulator on the VPS; `cipherbox-staging-tee-worker-1` now runs the simulator image from the `staging-YYYYMMDD-release-N` tag.
TEE worker simulator derives keys via HKDF-SHA256 from fixed seed `'cipherbox-tee-simulator-seed'` — deterministic, so epoch-1 pubkey matches dev DB without any migration needed.

Docker container `localhost` is not the host; the TEE container must use the host LAN IP (e.g. `192.168.133.12:5002`) to reach the Kubo container — `localhost:5002` inside the container points at itself.
GitHub Actions environment variables paginate at 10 per page by default; `gh api ... --paginate` or `?per_page=100` is required to see all variables.
process-level env vars injected at `pnpm dev` invocation override dotenv — useful for injecting secrets without touching `.env` files.
The TEE worker secret generated at container start is written to `/tmp/cipherbox-tee-secret.txt` for local dev reference.

code.finding: Bug (now fixed): `this.fetchFn = options?.fetchFn ?? globalThis.fetch` stores an unbound reference. When called as `this.fetchFn(url, ...)` the receiver is the provider instance, causing `TypeError: Failed to execute 'fetch' on 'Window': Illegal invocation` in browsers. Node's fetch is not this-sensitive so the bug was invisible to all automated tests. Fix: `globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis)`.
Identical unbound-fetch bug as kubo-provider.ts — same fix applied: `globalThis.fetch.bind(globalThis)`.

Provider construction (`new sdkCore.KuboProvider(ext.endpoint, ext.authToken)`) never passes `fetchFn`; that's fine now that the providers self-bind, but this is why the bug was latent — the only path to override fetch is via options, which nothing uses.

Silent catch block marks upload rows as error without logging — reason the unbound-fetch bug surfaced with 0% failure and zero console output, making it appear to be an env issue rather than a code bug.

Save button disabled when `mode !== 'cipherbox' && !testResult?.success` — requires a successful TEE connection test before external/dual mode can be saved. This gated all phase-21 UAT until the real TEE worker was running.

Poll loop: `if (status && TERMINAL_STATUSES.includes(status.status)) return;` — permanently stops on any terminal state with no restart path. A failed job from a prior session renders as 'migrating: 0/39' on next load.

Advisory quota badge renders correctly when `is_byo_user=true` in the vault, but the web app never calls `PATCH /vault/byo-status` anywhere, so the flag can only be set directly in the DB or from another client (e.g. desktop).
New regression test block added: stubs a this-sensitive `strictFetch` that throws `Illegal invocation` when called with wrong receiver — verified it fails with pre-fix code and passes with the fix.
Same regression test added. PSA mock response shape must be `{ pin: { cid: '...' }, status: 'pinned' }` because `pinByCid` maps `result.pin.cid`.

workflow: Puppeteer MCP can fully automate the CipherBox UAT flow including OTP login (read code from API logs), file operations, and logout/re-login lifecycle — no manual browser interaction required.
React fiber walking (`__reactFiber*` keys, `memoizedState` hook chains) can extract Zustand-fed component state in the browser when no `window.__store` is exposed.
vite `/@fs/<absolute-path>` dynamic imports allow running real workspace TypeScript source directly in the headed browser — useful for pinning provider verification without a build step.

Console wrapper instrumentation (overriding `console.error`/`console.warn`) can cause cascading RangeError floods during login initialization. XHR-only logging is safer. Always re-verify on a clean page when a large error count appears unexpectedly.

Arrow-function fetch wrappers (`window.fetch = (...args) => realFetch(...args)`) ignore `this` and will mask the `Illegal invocation` bug during negative-control testing. Use `function`-declared wrappers for this-sensitivity checks.
When a Puppeteer page reloads or the browser restarts, all `evaluate` handles become detached — re-navigate with `puppeteer_navigate` before further interaction.
Building the tee-worker Docker image requires `docker build -f apps/tee-worker/Dockerfile -t cipherbox-tee-worker .` from the repo root (multi-stage build with monorepo context).

friction: Initial upload failure appeared to be a local env issue but was actually an account config difference (pinning mode 'external only' → `http://192.168.133.12:5002`) combined with a real latent code bug — took significant debugging to separate the two.
Console instrumentation in the browser caused 5,498 fake RangeErrors during re-login, requiring a clean repro to rule it out as a product bug.
Arrow-wrapped `window.fetch` masked the negative-control test for the fix verification — needed a full page reload to confirm `fetch is native: true` before the negative control was trustworthy.
TEE_WORKER_URL defaulted to port 3001 (occupied by mock-ipns-routing which answers `/health`), causing the API to report a fake 'healthy' TEE while all actual TEE requests got 404s.
TEE container cannot reach `localhost:5002` — must use host LAN IP, which took multiple failed attempts to diagnose.
GitHub environment variable list truncated at 10 entries (default page size), causing a PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL variable to be initially missed.
`.env` files are off-limits (permission denied on read) — TEE secrets had to be injected as process-level env vars at server start instead.
psql queries required guessing column names (`processed_cids`→`migrated_cids`, `user_id`→`owner_id`) with no schema reference available.
1Password SSH agent locked/expired during git commit signing, requiring a retry.
Puppeteer browser frame detachment after page reloads required repeated re-navigation and re-login cycles.
An oversized tool result (1.9MB console flood) required switching to `head -c` / grep to read execution output.
open_items: Three diagnosed phase-21 gaps not yet fix-planned: (1) missing `PATCH /vault/byo-status` call in web save flow [major], (2) MigrationProgress polling never restarts after terminal job [minor], (3) migration stats double-count when API 120s batch timeout fires mid-batch [minor].

Two phase-35 gaps recorded: (1) orphaned CI secrets `PHALA_CLOUD_API_KEY` and `PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL` in GitHub should be deleted and the Phala key revoked, (2) stale docs gap was resolved in this session but the commit signing failed and may need retry.
`TEE_WORKER_URL` and `TEE_WORKER_SECRET` need to be persisted to `apps/api/.env` by the user — cannot be done by Claude (`.env` files are off-limits).
Branch `fix/pinning-provider-fetch-binding` has not been pushed or PR opened — was offered twice but superseded by other work.

Phase-21 full BYO upload e2e with the connection test working at `192.168.133.12:5002` still needs a retest after the fetch fix — verified at the provider level but the in-app save flow was gated during the session.
Migration failures: 10 of 57 pins failed during the phase-21 migration test run — root cause not fully investigated (likely IPFS relay connectivity for those specific CIDs).
Advisory quota badge (`is_byo_user` flag): the web save flow never calls `PATCH /vault/byo-status` — needs a product fix to wire this up after saving external/dual mode settings.
